entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [IDE] Inline errors are not displayed for syntax node actions that report diagnostics for parent nodes #80285
  • Remove ITypeSymbol extension APIs #80281
    Next Next
  • Usage of obsolete backing field should be highlighted #80277
    Next
  • Use standard LSP dynamic text documents for source generated files #80276

Closed

  • Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.MSBuild contains in code path to non existent folder in nuget package #72441
    18.0
  • Cannot apply user-defined conditional logical operators on built-in types #80257
    Next
  • LocalRewriter.TransformPropertyOrEventReceiver can return expression without rewriting it #79466
    Next
  • Consider changing logic in NamespaceSymbol.AddExtensionContainersForType #78275
    Next
  • Add using quickfix doesn't show new extension members #80240
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Reduce allocations in SourceGeneratedDocumentIdentity.Generate #80292
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Remove fallback for obtaining file-based program XML when SDK is too old #80291
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Delete the old Intellisense option pages #80290
    Area-IDE
  • Reduce allocations in SourceTextStream ctor #80289
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations in AnalyzerConfig.UnescapeSectionName #80288
    Area-Compilers
  • Reduce allocations in XmlDocumentationProvider.GetDocumentationForSymbol #80287
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Delete old workaround that's now obsolete #80286
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Reduce allocations in InlayHintHandler.GetInlayHintsAsync #80284
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Track proposal id in copilot adjustment requests #80280
    Area-IDE

Merged

  • Fix our registration for our TempPE compilers #80265
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Fix the fast-up-to-date check for pkgdef files #80269
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80282
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Small misc. adjustments #80275
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Support 'add using' for modern extensions members. #80278
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Move extensions to where they are actually called #80268
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode, Next
  • Address missed feedback on SyntaxGenerator #80249
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • *** WIP: Change DocumentAnalysisExecutor to use ValueTask #80293
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Invoke Created action from HotReloadException constructor #79790
    Area-Compilers
  • Report error when MetadataUpdateDeletedAttribute is applied manually #80125
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: DocumentationCommentId and ExtensionGroupingName/ExtensionMarkerName APIs, update grouping type metadata name #80164

  • Warn for redundant pattern in `not ... or <redundant>` pattern #75581
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Use dotnet run file for generating compiler code #80248
    Area-Compilers
  • Only publish to the VS feed for our official build #80009
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Fix 'GetRefEscape' for invocation using old rules #80261
    Area-Compilers
  • Add friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #80267

    Area-Compilers
